profile.description: Casper Oktoberfest is historically a one-afternoon downtown charity beer event benefiting Make-A-Wish Wyoming. Adult/21+ events are valid Adventure Zone prospects and must not be rejected solely because of alcohol service or age restriction. A current 2026 edition has not yet been officially verified. If confirmed, evaluate Warrior's Playground and other adult-oriented competitive attractions, plus footprint, event duration and route economics.

notes.subject: Correction — adult/21+ is not a non-fit reason
notes.body: Adventure Zone Gmail shows outreach to Casper Oktoberfest contacts in 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. The prior decision to close this primarily because it is a 21+ beer event was incorrect. First verify a real 2026 edition; if confirmed, evaluate Warrior's Playground/competitive attractions, space, operating window, economics and organizer interest.

followUps.label: Verify 2026 Casper Oktoberfest and adult-event fit
followUps.reason: Adult/21+ is not a disqualifier. Confirm a 2026 event first, then assess Warrior's Playground/competitive attraction fit before history-aware outreach.
